item.title: Career Change: From Linux Kernel Networking to Linux Graphics
item.description:
Changing Jobs

I wanted to announce that I am changing jobs. In my previous role, I worked at NVIDIA as a Linux kernel developer specifically focused on netdev changes for the ConnectX and BlueField products. You can find my relevant work in my previous position by searching my name on the netdev mailing list archives.

I am moving to a new role as part of NVIDIA's Linux Graphics Team. The team's work involves DRM/KMS, X11 and Wayland UMD work, as well as OpenGL and Vulkan support. Documentation related to the work can be found at https://download.nvidia.com/XFree86/Linux-x86_64/.
